purpose: Test whether the surviving JANUS lifecycle invariants are already native consequences of the closest public frameworks, or only encodable after adding JANUS-specific state/invariants.

evaluation_rule.warning: Bare logical expressibility is too weak a novelty discriminator. A sufficiently expressive assertion logic can encode arbitrary ghost ledgers, so 'can be encoded somehow' would trivially collapse the audit.

statuses.NATIVE: The published framework itself defines/enforces an equivalent state, invariant or transition discipline without adding JANUS-specific ghost state.
statuses.PARTIAL_NATIVE: A close published mechanism exists but does not enforce the full JANUS invariant.
statuses.ENCODABLE_WITH_CUSTOM_STATE: The framework is expressive enough to host the JANUS invariant only after adding explicit JANUS-style ghost variables/ledgers/transition rules.
statuses.NOT_FOUND_IN_AUDITED_PUBLIC_SURFACE: No matching native mechanism found in the inspected paper/repository/docs. This is not a proof of absence.

evaluation_rule.novelty_test: Only NATIVE coverage eliminates a JANUS residual directly. ENCODABLE_WITH_CUSTOM_STATE means the host framework could implement JANUS, but the missing invariant remains an added mechanism rather than a pre-existing theorem of that framework.

semantic_witness_obligation_partition.janus: X = V_live dot_union V_debt dot_union V_cert
semantic_witness_obligation_partition.note: GCC carries source-bound evidence and witnesses, but the audited public surface did not expose a conserved intermediate ledger in which existentially projected original witness obligations must move LIVE->DEBT->CERTIFIED.

dynamic_issued_operation_partition.note: GCC has route admission, refusal and work envelopes, but no matching native lifecycle where every newly required exact operation gets an immutable request identity that cannot disappear without EXECUTED_CERTIFIED or exact supersession.

pure_switch_zero_discharge.note: GCC's source/query binding, typed admission and exact fallback prevent unsupported routes from becoming answers, but the audited public materials did not state the JANUS conservation law that representation/certificate switching itself has exactly zero debt-discharge credit.

nonforgetful_charged_history.note: GCC explicitly measures producer/checker/resource work and preserves provenance, but no native monotone lifecycle law was found stating that an A->B->A semantic/representation roundtrip must retain all prior discovery/verification/materialization cost and liabilities.

scoped_negative_open_cache.note: REFUSED is native and correctly non-logical. Proof reuse/invalidation is also researched. The audited public surface did not reveal a persistent negative refusal cache keyed by (core, capability, semantic-authority scope) whose replay suppresses identical search while carrying no SAT/UNSAT or debt-discharge authority.

comparators.caution: Absence is based on inspected public materials and repository text search, not a formal proof that no unpublished or differently named implementation exists.

comparators.name: Certificate Translation for Optimizing Compilers
native_overlap: certificate translator T_cert maps a source certificate to a target certificate while T_spec maps the property/specification
per-optimization translators compose across a sequence of compiler passes
certifying analysis results can be additional proof inputs to justify optimizations
proof obligations are explicit and transformed rather than silently assumed
certificate size/translation cost is recognized as an engineering concern

generic_cross_representation_proof_trans.consequence: Generic JANUS cross-scope certificate-transfer novelty is killed. Proof/certificate authority transport across transformations and composition of such translators are old ideas.

semantic_witness_obligation_partition.note: One could extend the program/specification with ghost state representing V_live/V_debt/V_cert and prove its invariant, but this ledger is not a native consequence of certificate translation itself.

dynamic_issued_operation_partition.note: Proof obligations exist, but the published framework does not natively identify every dynamically issued future exact solver operation as a conserved lifecycle object with DEBT/CERT status. Such a ledger could be added as program/spec state.

pure_switch_zero_discharge.note: A translator can preserve arbitrary assertions if supplied with appropriate proofs, so zero-discharge can be specified; it is not the generic certificate-translation theorem itself.

nonforgetful_charged_history.note: Costs/certificate sizes are discussed, but a monotone historical work ledger is not part of certificate validity. It could be represented as ghost/accounting state, which would amount to adding the JANUS lifecycle invariant.

scoped_negative_open_cache.note: The 2006 framework is about successful certificate translation, not capability/scope-versioned persistent negative refusal knowledge.

comparators.name: Certifying Projected Knowledge Compilation
native_overlap: certifies equivalence between projected compiled representation and existentially quantified source formula
extends compiled representation with Skolem assignments for quantified variables
uses independently checkable proof framework
formal soundness validated in HOL4
checker validates representation properties needed for efficient counting

projection_plus_reconstruction_certifica.consequence: Projection + Skolem reconstruction + certified checking is not JANUS novelty.

semantic_witness_obligation_partition.note: Skolem POG natively carries reconstructed assignments for quantified variables at the certified output. The paper does not define the JANUS intermediate conservation discipline in which each original witness obligation remains explicitly LIVE or DEBT until a certified discharge transition.

dynamic_issued_operation_partition.note: The framework certifies a projected-compilation result; it does not expose a dynamic Q_issued/Q_debt/Q_cert lifecycle for arbitrary exact operations requested during synthesis.

pure_switch_zero_discharge.note: Compilation equivalence is certified and proof steps preserve correctness, but no separate lifecycle progress accounting was found where a representation change is formally assigned zero progress unless it closes an external debt ledger.

nonforgetful_charged_history.note: Proof-generation/checking scalability and proof size are studied, but not an append-only historical work/liability invariant across representation roundtrips.

scoped_negative_open_cache.note: No capability/scope-keyed negative refusal memory was found in the paper.

comparators.name: Knowledge Compilation Map
native_overlap: compilation languages analyzed by succinctness
queries supported in polynomial time
transformations supported in polynomial time
comparators.consequence: The concept of selecting/characterizing a carrier by supported efficient operations is established. JANUS must not claim Capability Passport as a primitive novelty.
comparators.missing_relative_to_janus: The map is a static language-level classification, not a per-run conserved obligation/cost/refusal lifecycle.

key_conclusion.reason: No audited framework natively supplied all four surviving JANUS lifecycle invariants together: fixed witness-obligation conservation, dynamic issued-operation conservation, nonforgetful charged-history across representation roundtrips, and capability+semantic-scope keyed negative OPEN memory.
key_conclusion.important_caveat: Certificate Translation and other expressive proof frameworks can encode many of these invariants if JANUS-specific ghost state and transition rules are added. Therefore the defensible residual is not 'inexpressible elsewhere'; it is 'not a native invariant of the audited framework without adding the JANUS lifecycle state machine.'

next_no_redundant_work_gate.next_theory_question: Can the surviving dual-debt/nonforgetful/negative-OPEN state machine be embedded into one closest framework using only its existing native objects and rules, with no JANUS-specific ghost ledgers? If not, identify the minimal added state/rules and formalize only that delta.
